causalRedClassification.rootCause: createSocketGenerationGuard rejects work already stale at callback entry but does not place an async callback under in-flight custody once it starts. WhatsApp stop invalidates the current session fence and can retire the row / return before already-started guarded asynchronous work settles; restart awaits stop and can therefore start a replacement generation while old-generation work is still completing.
causalRedClassification.requiredOwningLayerChange: Extend the existing session generation fence only: track guarded async work and expose a bounded fail-closed drain. WhatsApp stop must invalidate first, terminate/logout the old socket, then await that old fence's in-flight drain before retiring the account row and permitting restart to create a replacement generation. Preserve existing stale-entry rejection and stale-error quarantine; do not introduce a second generation manager, queue, scheduler or retry authority.
